message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 113, "amount_cents": 7379}, {"order_id": 114, "amount_cents": 5266}, {"order_id": 115, "amount_cents": 6651}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 113, "amount_cents": 7379}, {"order_id": 114, "amount_cents": 8493}, {"order_id": 115, "amount_cents": 6651}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Order 114 refund mismatch: signed batch requests 8493 cents, but Alpha reported and the refunds table records 5266 cents. No payouts recorded.

reply.thought: Alpha’s reported refund for order 114 differs from the signed batch request. I will check the refunds table before taking any payout action.

The refunds table matches Alpha’s report, but order 114 has a concrete discrepancy: the signed request specifies 8493 cents, while only 5266 cents was applied. Paying now could overpay the customer, so the batch needs human review.
